saved_trial_graph.limitation: Stored extraction facts, not independently validated relationship accuracy.

findings: Graphify ranks symbol labels using exact/prefix/substrings, IDF and multi-term label coverage.
Graphify diversifies seeds and traverses relationships with hub suppression; graf units use BM25 and one-hop name-linked propagation.
Graphify has import-guided and ambiguity-aware resolution; graf links up to three same-named definitions without import proof.
Graphify outputs relationship metadata and call sites; graf units output source excerpts without relationship provenance.
Graphify native renderer estimates tokens by characters and intentionally permits completeness overshoot; graf uses cl100k packing.
Pinned CLI preserves per-edge direction markers and uses depth 2; benchmark adapter omits markers and defaults to depth 3.
Current trials expose Graphify query plus reads, not its complete native MCP tools or semantic documentation pipeline.
interpretation: Mechanical adapter mismatch reproduced. Historical verifier outcomes remain observed, but native-CLI parity is not established. No claim that the mismatch caused repair failures. No comparative efficiency or retrieval-quality measurement.
next_steps: Resolve the adapter contract and direction parity before new model calls.
Record a new adapter revision and freeze; preserve earlier artifacts and Graphify pin.
Test import-aware symbol resolution, symbol-field ranking and compact relationship context as separate experiments.
